meta.description: The finale begins with a bloody battle.

units.rawText: Inside the Neural Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: Inside the Neural Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ahhhhh! What a pain!</size>
units.displayText: Ahhhhh! What a pain!

spans.text: Ahhhhh! What a pain!

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll narrowly evades a tentacle and drives her pile bunker into the monster before her.

units.rawText: Hsss!
units.displayText: Hsss!

units.rawText: The creature hisses and hits the ground. Havoc pulls her slime-caked weapon free, and as she wipes the goo off it, she pulls out the spike which has been bent into uselessness and tosses it aside.
units.displayText: The creature hisses and hits the ground. Havoc pulls her slime-caked weapon free, and as she wipes the goo off it, she pulls out the spike which has been bent into uselessness and tosses it aside.

units.rawText: How many more drive spikes do I have... Ah, just one more, huh...
units.displayText: How many more drive spikes do I have... Ah, just one more, huh...

spans.text: How many more drive spikes do I have... Ah, just one more, huh...

units.rawText: She looks into the distance, at the endless stream of Entropics pouring in. For the first time, she begins to feel down about not preparing well enough for work.
units.displayText: She looks into the distance, at the endless stream of Entropics pouring in. For the first time, she begins to feel down about not preparing well enough for work.

spans.text: She looks into the distance, at the endless stream of Entropics pouring in. For the first time, she begins to feel down about not preparing well enough for work.

units.rawText: There's just no end to them, is there? Why are there more and more of them...
units.displayText: There's just no end to them, is there? Why are there more and more of them...

spans.text: There's just no end to them, is there? Why are there more and more of them...

units.rawText: Eh... just keep drilling till I can't drill no more, I guess.
units.displayText: Eh... just keep drilling till I can't drill no more, I guess.

spans.text: Eh... just keep drilling till I can't drill no more, I guess.

units.rawText: Havoc, you should stop.
units.displayText: Havoc, you should stop.

spans.text: Havoc, you should stop.

units.rawText: Aw, I'm fine, I'm not going to keel over just yet.
units.displayText: Aw, I'm fine, I'm not going to keel over just yet.

spans.text: Aw, I'm fine, I'm not going to keel over just yet.

units.rawText: I know that, but...
units.displayText: I know that, but...

spans.text: I know that, but...

units.rawText: Hatsuchiri shakes her head, interrupting Havoc and her intentions to keep fighting.
units.displayText: Hatsuchiri shakes her head, interrupting Havoc and her intentions to keep fighting.

spans.text: Hatsuchiri shakes her head, interrupting Havoc and her intentions to keep fighting.

units.rawText: The Entropics have finished massing up. There is a limit to what we can do, so we'd be better off saving operands for the fighting later on.
units.displayText: The Entropics have finished massing up. There is a limit to what we can do, so we'd be better off saving operands for the fighting later on.

units.rawText: De Lacey, how much longer until the Professor and the others arrive?
units.displayText: De Lacey, how much longer until the Professor and the others arrive?

spans.text: De Lacey, how much longer until the Professor and the others arrive?

units.rawText: Sector Entropization is so high that we can't contact the Professor anymore. Before comms were cut, they said they were on the way here. ETA 10 minutes.
units.displayText: Sector Entropization is so high that we can't contact the Professor anymore. Before comms were cut, they said they were on the way here. ETA 10 minutes.

spans.text: Sector Entropization is so high that we can't contact the Professor anymore. Before comms were cut, they said they were on the way here. ETA 10 minutes.

units.rawText: 10 minutes, huh... Doesn't look like he's going to wait that long, though.
units.displayText: 10 minutes, huh... Doesn't look like he's going to wait that long, though.

spans.text: 10 minutes, huh... Doesn't look like he's going to wait that long, though.

units.rawText: De Lacey looks where Sueyoi is pointing, off in the distance.
units.displayText: De Lacey looks where Sueyoi is pointing, off in the distance.

spans.text: De Lacey looks where Sueyoi is pointing, off in the distance.

units.rawText: The unruly Entropic hordes have settled down and the writhing tide parts, making way for their king in silence.
units.displayText: The unruly Entropic hordes have settled down and the writhing tide parts, making way for their king in silence.

spans.text: The unruly Entropic hordes have settled down and the writhing tide parts, making way for their king in silence.

units.rawText: Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Eosphorus...

spans.text: Eosphorus...

units.rawText: I know we promised the Professor to buy some time, but an opponent like that is way too tricky... Especially since we just took out a High-Order Entropic's clone.
units.displayText: I know we promised the Professor to buy some time, but an opponent like that is way too tricky... Especially since we just took out a High-Order Entropic's clone.

spans.text: I know we promised the Professor to buy some time, but an opponent like that is way too tricky... Especially since we just took out a High-Order Entropic's clone.

units.rawText: Lind's mechanical arms rip an Entropic apart, but the sparks flying from it suggest that her condition isn't exactly very good either.
units.displayText: Lind's mechanical arms rip an Entropic apart, but the sparks flying from it suggest that her condition isn't exactly very good either.

spans.text: Lind's mechanical arms rip an Entropic apart, but the sparks flying from it suggest that her condition isn't exactly very good either.

units.rawText: Our operands are almost gone. If we try to take him in a straight fight, we'll be facing a greater risk than the Boss' initial estimate.
units.displayText: Our operands are almost gone. If we try to take him in a straight fight, we'll be facing a greater risk than the Boss' initial estimate.

spans.text: Our operands are almost gone. If we try to take him in a straight fight, we'll be facing a greater risk than the Boss' initial estimate.

units.rawText: Well, you've got command, De Lacey. What should we do next?
units.displayText: Well, you've got command, De Lacey. What should we do next?

spans.text: Well, you've got command, De Lacey. What should we do next?

units.rawText: Um... For safety's sake, you should all withdraw ASAP.
units.displayText: Um... For safety's sake, you should all withdraw ASAP.

spans.text: Um... For safety's sake, you should all withdraw ASAP.

units.rawText: Her mechanical tail moves in front of her, prepared to fight to the end even before its master commanded it to move.
units.displayText: Her mechanical tail moves in front of her, prepared to fight to the end even before its master commanded it to move.

spans.text: Her mechanical tail moves in front of her, prepared to fight to the end even before its master commanded it to move.

units.rawText: Even if it means I'm the only one left...
units.displayText: Even if it means I'm the only one left...

spans.text: Even if it means I'm the only one left...

units.rawText: This is no time for you to be acting cool, you know.
units.displayText: This is no time for you to be acting cool, you know.

spans.text: This is no time for you to be acting cool, you know.

units.rawText: I'm going to finish this job strong so I can hold my head up high and ask the Boss for more vacation days!
units.displayText: I'm going to finish this job strong so I can hold my head up high and ask the Boss for more vacation days!

spans.text: I'm going to finish this job strong so I can hold my head up high and ask the Boss for more vacation days!

units.rawText: Havi...
units.displayText: Havi...

spans.text: Havi...

units.rawText: I, for one, would like to sock that Eosphorus asshole right in his face. There's no way I'll be passing up on that.
units.displayText: I, for one, would like to sock that Eosphorus asshole right in his face. There's no way I'll be passing up on that.

spans.text: I, for one, would like to sock that Eosphorus asshole right in his face. There's no way I'll be passing up on that.

units.rawText: Or rather, nobody was planning to retreat in the first place.
units.displayText: Or rather, nobody was planning to retreat in the first place.

spans.text: Or rather, nobody was planning to retreat in the first place.

units.rawText: Hacchy, Suu...
units.displayText: Hacchy, Suu...

spans.text: Hacchy, Suu...

units.rawText: Alright, then! Since it's decided, we'll give them a taste of Team Arcadia's might!
units.displayText: Alright, then! Since it's decided, we'll give them a taste of Team Arcadia's might!

spans.text: Alright, then! Since it's decided, we'll give them a taste of Team Arcadia's might!

units.rawText: The group jumps down from the data debris of the sector with weapons in hand to stand in the way of the new king of Magrasea.
units.displayText: The group jumps down from the data debris of the sector with weapons in hand to stand in the way of the new king of Magrasea.

spans.text: The group jumps down from the data debris of the sector with weapons in hand to stand in the way of the new king of Magrasea.

units.rawText: You won't be getting into the upload passage that easily! Relax, we'll hold you tight like a rubber band.
units.displayText: You won't be getting into the upload passage that easily! Relax, we'll hold you tight like a rubber band.

spans.text: You won't be getting into the upload passage that easily! Relax, we'll hold you tight like a rubber band.

units.rawText: We'll protect the Neural Cloud Sector until the Professor gets here!
units.displayText: We'll protect the Neural Cloud Sector until the Professor gets here!

spans.text: We'll protect the Neural Cloud Sector until the Professor gets here!

units.rawText: I'm picking up huge operand fluctuations in the Neural Cloud Sector! It looks like De Lacey and the others are engaging Eosphorus!
units.displayText: I'm picking up huge operand fluctuations in the Neural Cloud Sector! It looks like De Lacey and the others are engaging Eosphorus!

spans.text: I'm picking up huge operand fluctuations in the Neural Cloud Sector! It looks like De Lacey and the others are engaging Eosphorus!

units.rawText: We can't waste the time they've bought for us... Persicaria, how much longer till we reach the upload device?
units.displayText: We can't waste the time they've bought for us... Persicaria, how much longer till we reach the upload device?

spans.text: We can't waste the time they've bought for us... Persicaria, how much longer till we reach the upload device?

units.rawText: That would be 8 minutes at the minimum. The Entropics are attacking every single sector at once to keep us from sending out reinforcements.
units.displayText: That would be 8 minutes at the minimum. The Entropics are attacking every single sector at once to keep us from sending out reinforcements.

spans.text: That would be 8 minutes at the minimum. The Entropics are attacking every single sector at once to keep us from sending out reinforcements.

units.rawText: ...I've transferred Dolls from the Oasis per your instructions, but they'll still take around 20 minutes to arrive.
units.displayText: ...I've transferred Dolls from the Oasis per your instructions, but they'll still take around 20 minutes to arrive.

spans.text: ...I've transferred Dolls from the Oasis per your instructions, but they'll still take around 20 minutes to arrive.

units.rawText: 20 minutes, huh... That's not good...
units.displayText: 20 minutes, huh... That's not good...

spans.text: 20 minutes, huh... That's not good...

units.rawText: Irida taps her wrist and the red countdown timer once again appears in front of everyone.
units.displayText: Irida taps her wrist and the red countdown timer once again appears in front of everyone.

spans.text: Irida taps her wrist and the red countdown timer once again appears in front of everyone.

units.rawText: We have less than 20 minutes until the passage opens.
units.displayText: We have less than 20 minutes until the passage opens.

spans.text: We have less than 20 minutes until the passage opens.

units.rawText: ...In that case, we'll have to stop Eosphorus by ourselves. We can't let him get to reality, no matter what.
units.displayText: ...In that case, we'll have to stop Eosphorus by ourselves. We can't let him get to reality, no matter what.

spans.text: ...In that case, we'll have to stop Eosphorus by ourselves. We can't let him get to reality, no matter what.

units.rawText: Since time is tight, we'll be splitting up to execute our parts of the plan. Antonina, I need you and Professor Irida to hack into the upload device and see if we can use her authorizations to stop the transfer.
units.displayText: Since time is tight, we'll be splitting up to execute our parts of the plan. Antonina, I need you and Professor Irida to hack into the upload device and see if we can use her authorizations to stop the transfer.

spans.text: Since time is tight, we'll be splitting up to execute our parts of the plan. Antonina, I need you and Professor Irida to hack into the upload device and see if we can use her authorizations to stop the transfer.

units.rawText: Persicaria, we need to meet up with De Lacey and fight. We have to buy enough time for the rest of our people to arrive and meet up with us.
units.displayText: Persicaria, we need to meet up with De Lacey and fight. We have to buy enough time for the rest of our people to arrive and meet up with us.

spans.text: Persicaria, we need to meet up with De Lacey and fight. We have to buy enough time for the rest of our people to arrive and meet up with us.

units.rawText: Professor Irida and I will do our best. If we can shut down the upload device before Eosphorus enters it, that's a win for us.
units.displayText: Professor Irida and I will do our best. If we can shut down the upload device before Eosphorus enters it, that's a win for us.

spans.text: Professor Irida and I will do our best. If we can shut down the upload device before Eosphorus enters it, that's a win for us.

units.rawText: So you guys need to take care of yourselves. Remember, your job is to delay him, not throw your lives away.
units.displayText: So you guys need to take care of yourselves. Remember, your job is to delay him, not throw your lives away.

spans.text: So you guys need to take care of yourselves. Remember, your job is to
delay
him, not throw your lives away.

units.rawText: Yeah, I got it.
units.displayText: Yeah, I got it.

spans.text: Yeah, I got it.

units.rawText: ...Hearing you say that actually makes me feel more worried instead.
units.displayText: ...Hearing you say that actually makes me feel more worried instead.

spans.text: ...Hearing you say that actually makes me feel more worried instead.

units.rawText: It's alright. I'll keep an eye on Persicaria and make sure she doesn't go too far.
units.displayText: It's alright. I'll keep an eye on Persicaria and make sure she doesn't go too far.

spans.text: It's alright. I'll keep an eye on Persicaria and make sure she doesn't go too far.

units.rawText: Sorry to interrupt your discussion, but the upload device is just ahead.
units.displayText: Sorry to interrupt your discussion, but the upload device is just ahead.

spans.text: Sorry to interrupt your discussion, but the upload device is just ahead.

units.rawText: Just as Professor Irida said, we can glimpse the upload device through the piles of data debris.
units.displayText: Just as Professor Irida said, we can glimpse the upload device through the piles of data debris.

spans.text: Just as Professor Irida said, we can glimpse the upload device through the piles of data debris.

units.rawText: ...That's strange. Aren't there any Entropics guarding this place?
units.displayText: ...That's strange. Aren't there any Entropics guarding this place?

spans.text: ...That's strange. Aren't there any Entropics guarding this place?

units.rawText: I had Salmon lead a team to sweep it ahead of time.
units.displayText: I had Salmon lead a team to sweep it ahead of time.

spans.text: I had Salmon lead a team to sweep it ahead of time.

units.rawText: He might be a mad dog, but he's very efficient when it comes to this sort of work.
units.displayText: He might be a mad dog, but he's very efficient when it comes to this sort of work.

spans.text: He might be a mad dog, but he's very efficient when it comes to this sort of work.

units.rawText: Professor Irida, it seems you've been doing a lot of things behind our backs.
units.displayText: Professor Irida, it seems you've been doing a lot of things behind our backs.

spans.text: Professor Irida, it seems you've been doing a lot of things behind our backs.

units.rawText: Irida's only response to Antonina's snark is a wicked smile and a shrug.
units.displayText: Irida's only response to Antonina's snark is a wicked smile and a shrug.

spans.text: Irida's only response to Antonina's snark is a wicked smile and a shrug.

units.rawText: Let's not worry about that for now. Antonina, how is contacting the outside world going?
units.displayText: Let's not worry about that for now. Antonina, how is contacting the outside world going?

spans.text: Let's not worry about that for now. Antonina, how is contacting the outside world going?

units.rawText: Mm, I've already established a comm channel using Professor Irida's permissions. Once the outside world opens the transfer passage, we can send a distress signal!
units.displayText: Mm, I've already established a comm channel using Professor Irida's permissions. Once the outside world opens the transfer passage, we can send a distress signal!

spans.text: Mm, I've already established a comm channel using Professor Irida's permissions. Once the outside world opens the transfer passage, we can send a distress signal!

units.rawText: She points the computer screen toward me. The "Connecting..." icon blinks for a bit before changing to "Connection Failed".
units.displayText: She points the computer screen toward me. The "Connecting..." icon blinks for a bit before changing to "Connection Failed".

spans.text: She points the computer screen toward me. The "Connecting..." icon blinks for a bit before changing to "Connection Failed".

units.rawText: ...If we can contact Professor Persica, we might be able to close the transfer passage before he goes through.
units.displayText: ...If we can contact Professor Persica, we might be able to close the transfer passage before he goes through.

spans.text: ...If we can contact Professor Persica, we might be able to close the transfer passage before he goes through.

units.rawText: Alright, keep trying. De Lacey and the others should be close. We'll meet up, then cover you as you hack!
units.displayText: Alright, keep trying. De Lacey and the others should be close. We'll meet up, then cover you as you hack!

spans.text: Alright, keep trying. De Lacey and the others should be close. We'll meet up, then cover you as you hack!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: 124 days, 124 days and 1 hour, 124 days and 2 hours...
units.displayText: 124 days, 124 days and 1 hour, 124 days and 2 hours...

spans.text: 124 days, 124 days and 1 hour, 124 days and 2 hours...

units.rawText: Havi, what are you counting?
units.displayText: Havi, what are you counting?

spans.text: Havi, what are you counting?

units.rawText: I'm counting the number of vacation days I'll be getting from the Boss! That's the only way to motivate me enough to keep going!
units.displayText: I'm counting the number of vacation days I'll be getting from the Boss! That's the only way to motivate me enough to keep going!

spans.text: I'm counting the number of vacation days I'll be getting from the Boss! That's the only way to motivate me enough to keep going!

units.displayText: The green-haired Doll takes up her weapon and stands in front of the others, blocking an incoming meteor's explosion as she does.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll takes up her weapon and stands in front of the others, blocking an incoming meteor's explosion as she does.

units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi work in unison to cut a meteor in two with their polearms. Havoc deploys a shield and establishes a defense line for them.
units.displayText: Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi work in unison to cut a meteor in two with their polearms. Havoc deploys a shield and establishes a defense line for them.

spans.text: Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi work in unison to cut a meteor in two with their polearms. Havoc deploys a shield and establishes a defense line for them.

units.rawText: Man... How many meteors has it been now? How come he can keep spamming all these powerful attacks...
units.displayText: Man... How many meteors has it been now? How come he can keep spamming all these powerful attacks...

spans.text: Man... How many meteors has it been now? How come he can keep spamming all these powerful attacks...

units.rawText: To be precise, that was the 22nd one. In other words, he has performed that attack 22 times. Fortunately, we can still handle it...
units.displayText: To be precise, that was the 22nd one. In other words, he has performed that attack 22 times. Fortunately, we can still handle it...

spans.text: To be precise, that was the 22nd one. In other words, he has performed that attack 22 times. Fortunately, we can still handle it...

units.rawText: But the flip side of that is that we can't really do much more than that.
units.displayText: But the flip side of that is that we can't really do much more than that.

spans.text: But the flip side of that is that we can't really do much more than that.

units.rawText: Lind crouches down and prepares to attack again, but Eosphorus summons another meteor and forces her to go on the defensive.
units.displayText: Lind crouches down and prepares to attack again, but Eosphorus summons another meteor and forces her to go on the defensive.

spans.text: Lind crouches down and prepares to attack again, but Eosphorus summons another meteor and forces her to go on the defensive.

units.rawText: While we are keeping him away from the upload device, it just looks like he's taking pity on us, no matter how you slice it.
units.displayText: While we are keeping him away from the upload device, it just looks like he's taking pity on us, no matter how you slice it.

are
keeping him away from the upload device, it just looks like he's taking pity on us, no matter how you slice it.

units.rawText: Man, this is pissing me off... Is he mocking us?
units.displayText: Man, this is pissing me off... Is he mocking us?

spans.text: Man, this is pissing me off... Is he mocking us?

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea does not respond, only looking down on the ants beneath him with a pitying gaze.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea does not respond, only looking down on the ants beneath him with a pitying gaze.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea does not respond, only looking down on the ants beneath him with a pitying gaze.

units.rawText: Dammit... say, didn't he fork off part of his neural cloud? How come he doesn't seem to be running out of operands at all...

spans.text: Dammit... say, didn't he fork off part of his neural cloud? How come he doesn't seem to be running out of operands at all...

units.rawText: Also, didn't the Professor say he's using Entropic power too? He hasn't shown it even once... is he mocking us?

units.rawText: That is very strange.

is
very strange.

units.rawText: The black-haired Doll suddenly thinks of something, then he frowns and looks up at the Sanctifier in the sky.
units.displayText: The black-haired Doll suddenly thinks of something, then he frowns and looks up at the Sanctifier in the sky.

spans.text: The black-haired Doll suddenly thinks of something, then he frowns and looks up at the Sanctifier in the sky.

units.rawText: Wait a minute, don't tell me...
units.displayText: Wait a minute, don't tell me...

spans.text: Wait a minute, don't tell me...

units.rawText: Sueyoi?
units.displayText: Sueyoi?

spans.text: Sueyoi?

units.rawText: I have a hypothesis I would like to verify. Could you help make an opportunity for me?
units.displayText: I have a hypothesis I would like to verify. Could you help make an opportunity for me?

spans.text: I have a hypothesis I would like to verify. Could you help make an opportunity for me?

units.rawText: Yeah, got it.
units.displayText: Yeah, got it.

spans.text: Yeah, got it.

units.rawText: Ohh! Sueyoi, is it time for "that"?
units.displayText: Ohh! Sueyoi, is it time for "that"?

spans.text: Ohh! Sueyoi, is it time for "that"?

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll eagerly limbers up her arms, preparing to show off her special move for the first time in a long time.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll eagerly limbers up her arms, preparing to show off her special move for the first time in a long time.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll eagerly limbers up her arms, preparing to show off her special move for the first time in a long time.

units.rawText: Mm... I didn't think Suu would suggest something like that. Are you sure you want to go with an unreliable combo move like this?
units.displayText: Mm... I didn't think Suu would suggest something like that. Are you sure you want to go with an unreliable combo move like this?

units.rawText: It's the best way to verify my hypothesis.
units.displayText: It's the best way to verify my hypothesis.

units.rawText: Haha, well then, since even Sueyoi agrees, I have no choice. Steady now!
units.displayText: Haha, well then, since even Sueyoi agrees, I have no choice. Steady now!

spans.text: Haha, well then, since even Sueyoi agrees, I have no choice. Steady now!

units.displayText: Havoc suddenly deploys her shields and hoists Sueyoi up on it. Then, she braces her pile bunker against it and launches Sueyoi right into Eosphorus' face.

spans.text: Havoc suddenly deploys her shields and hoists Sueyoi up on it. Then, she braces her pile bunker against it and launches Sueyoi right into Eosphorus' face.

units.displayText: The king of Magrasea is not threatened by this sudden closing of the distance. He moves his finger again and two massive meteors emanating a crushing aura of despair move in front of the black-haired Doll.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea is not threatened by this sudden closing of the distance. He moves his finger again and two massive meteors emanating a crushing aura of despair move in front of the black-haired Doll.

units.displayText: Before the meteors can destroy their target, Lind and Hatsuchiri intercept the incoming extraterrestrial bodies. There is a deafening explosion and the meteors are blown to bits in mid-air.

units.displayText: Kaboom—

units.rawText: <size=40>Now!</size>
units.displayText: Now!

spans.text: Now!

units.rawText: Ha!
units.displayText: Ha!

spans.text: Ha!

units.rawText: Sueyoi swings his pike and shatters the stars gathered behind Eosphorus. For just a moment, everyone can see the tentacles hidden in the darkness as they writhe about.
units.displayText: Sueyoi swings his pike and shatters the stars gathered behind Eosphorus. For just a moment, everyone can see the tentacles hidden in the darkness as they writhe about.

spans.text: Sueyoi swings his pike and shatters the stars gathered behind Eosphorus. For just a moment, everyone can see the tentacles hidden in the darkness as they writhe about.

units.rawText: ...So that's where you hid the Entropics.
units.displayText: ...So that's where you hid the Entropics.

spans.text: ...So
that's
where you hid the Entropics.

units.rawText: Sueyoi turns to attack Magrasea's king. The spear's tip is blocked by a shield, and the black-haired Doll uses this opportunity to touch down and return to Havoc's side.
units.displayText: Sueyoi turns to attack Magrasea's king. The spear's tip is blocked by a shield, and the black-haired Doll uses this opportunity to touch down and return to Havoc's side.

spans.text: Sueyoi turns to attack Magrasea's king. The spear's tip is blocked by a shield, and the black-haired Doll uses this opportunity to touch down and return to Havoc's side.

units.rawText: Huh? So... there were Entropics hidden behind that patch of starry sky?
units.displayText: Huh? So... there were Entropics hidden behind that patch of starry sky?

spans.text: Huh? So... there were Entropics hidden behind that patch of starry sky?

units.rawText: Yup. He wasn't looking down on us; he was secretly using his Entropic power to work on the upload device and he couldn't allow himself to be distracted.
units.displayText: Yup. He wasn't looking down on us; he was secretly using his Entropic power to work on the upload device and he couldn't allow himself to be distracted.

spans.text: Yup. He wasn't looking down on us; he was secretly using his Entropic power to work on the upload device and he couldn't allow himself to be distracted.

units.rawText: He coldly eyes the Sanctifier floating silently in the sky.
units.displayText: He coldly eyes the Sanctifier floating silently in the sky.

spans.text: He coldly eyes the Sanctifier floating silently in the sky.

units.rawText: While I don't know what he's up to, we need to stop him before he finishes doing it!
units.displayText: While I don't know what he's up to, we need to stop him before he finishes doing it!

spans.text: While I don't know what he's up to, we need to stop him before he finishes doing it!

units.rawText: A good idea, but unfortunately, you missed your chance.
units.displayText: A good idea, but unfortunately, you missed your chance.

spans.text: A good idea, but unfortunately, you missed your chance.

units.rawText: A shocking amount of operands is released, making the very space around them tremble. Magrasea's king looks down at the people on the ground, and his golden eyes once again fill with wrath.
units.displayText: A shocking amount of operands is released, making the very space around them tremble. Magrasea's king looks down at the people on the ground, and his golden eyes once again fill with wrath.

spans.text: A shocking amount of operands is released, making the very space around them tremble. Magrasea's king looks down at the people on the ground, and his golden eyes once again fill with wrath.

units.rawText: The number of starlight motes in the sky multiplies several times over, enough to turn the night into day.
units.displayText: The number of starlight motes in the sky multiplies several times over, enough to turn the night into day.

spans.text: The number of starlight motes in the sky multiplies several times over, enough to turn the night into day.

units.rawText: ...Were we too late?
units.displayText: ...Were we too late?

spans.text: ...Were we too late?

units.rawText: That is all for your efforts.
units.displayText: That is all for your efforts.

spans.text: That is all for your efforts.

units.rawText: I thank you for your valiant attempts at humor. They made for an excellent sideshow... But now, it is time for you to exit the stage.
units.displayText: I thank you for your valiant attempts at humor. They made for an excellent sideshow... But now, it is time for you to exit the stage.

spans.text: I thank you for your valiant attempts at humor. They made for an excellent sideshow... But now, it is time for you to exit the stage.

units.rawText: Professor, we're here! The upload device is up ahead and De Lacey's signal isn't far away...
units.displayText: Professor, we're here! The upload device is up ahead and De Lacey's signal isn't far away...

spans.text: Professor, we're here! The upload device is up ahead and De Lacey's signal isn't far away...

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl senses danger and deploys a shield to shelter all of us.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl senses danger and deploys a shield to shelter all of us.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl senses danger and deploys a shield to shelter all of us.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: A mighty shockwave hits us. Part of the shield splinters and Antonina has to hastily reallocate her operands to keep the explosion from leaking through.
units.displayText: A mighty shockwave hits us. Part of the shield splinters and Antonina has to hastily reallocate her operands to keep the explosion from leaking through.

spans.text: A mighty shockwave hits us. Part of the shield splinters and Antonina has to hastily reallocate her operands to keep the explosion from leaking through.

units.rawText: What the hell was with that crazy explosion...
units.displayText: What the hell was with that crazy explosion...

spans.text: What the hell was with that crazy explosion...

units.rawText: After lowering her shield, the green-haired Doll begins complaining, but then she notices something unusual on the shattered ground nearby.
units.displayText: After lowering her shield, the green-haired Doll begins complaining, but then she notices something unusual on the shattered ground nearby.

spans.text: After lowering her shield, the green-haired Doll begins complaining, but then she notices something unusual on the shattered ground nearby.

units.rawText: That's...!
units.displayText: That's...!

spans.text: That's...!

units.rawText: Havoc?!
units.displayText: Havoc?!

spans.text: Havoc?!

units.rawText: (Winces) Owww... that... hurt...
units.displayText: (Winces) Owww... that... hurt...

spans.text: (Winces) Owww... that... hurt...

units.rawText: I can't believe she's so badly hurt... Eosphorus, you bastard...
units.displayText: I can't believe she's so badly hurt... Eosphorus, you bastard...

spans.text: I can't believe she's so badly hurt... Eosphorus, you bastard...

units.rawText: Don't force yourself to stand up! Professor Irida! Please contact our rear support and get them to heal her!
units.displayText: Don't force yourself to stand up! Professor Irida! Please contact our rear support and get them to heal her!

spans.text: Don't force yourself to stand up! Professor Irida! Please contact our rear support and get them to heal her!

units.rawText: Got it. Hang in there, Havoc! Help is on the way!
units.displayText: Got it. Hang in there, Havoc! Help is on the way!

spans.text: Got it. Hang in there, Havoc! Help is on the way!

units.rawText: Are they now... Hey, the Boss is... She's here...
units.displayText: Are they now... Hey, the Boss is... She's here...

spans.text: Are they now... Hey, the Boss is... She's here...

units.rawText: Her neural cloud is starting to malfunction from the massive beating that her frame has taken. Even so, she still tries to reach out and see what's happening.
units.displayText: Her neural cloud is starting to malfunction from the massive beating that her frame has taken. Even so, she still tries to reach out and see what's happening.

spans.text: Her neural cloud is starting to malfunction from the massive beating that her frame has taken. Even so, she still tries to reach out and see what's happening.

units.rawText: Did we... finish our mission...
units.displayText: Did we... finish our mission...

spans.text: Did we... finish our mission...

units.rawText: Yes, you've done very well.
units.displayText: Yes, you've done very well.

spans.text: Yes, you've done very well.

units.rawText: That so... Haha, I rarely ever work this hard...
units.displayText: That so... Haha, I rarely ever work this hard...

spans.text: That so... Haha, I rarely ever work this hard...

units.rawText: So... let me rest for a bit, yeah...
units.displayText: So... let me rest for a bit, yeah...

spans.text: So... let me rest for a bit, yeah...

units.rawText: Havoc, De Lacey, Lind, Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi... Thank you all for your hard work. Leave the rest to us now.
units.displayText: Havoc, De Lacey, Lind, Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi... Thank you all for your hard work. Leave the rest to us now.

spans.text: Havoc, De Lacey, Lind, Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi... Thank you all for your hard work. Leave the rest to us now.

units.rawText: ...Kay.
units.displayText: ...Kay.

spans.text: ...Kay.

units.rawText: After seeing the support agents arrive, the badly-wounded members of Team Arcadia finally allow themselves to pass out.
units.displayText: After seeing the support agents arrive, the badly-wounded members of Team Arcadia finally allow themselves to pass out.

spans.text: After seeing the support agents arrive, the badly-wounded members of Team Arcadia finally allow themselves to pass out.

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: Keep Havoc and the others safe. This place is going to become very dangerous, so take them to safety before commencing treatment.
units.displayText: Keep Havoc and the others safe. This place is going to become very dangerous, so take them to safety before commencing treatment.

spans.text: Keep Havoc and the others safe. This place is going to become very dangerous, so take them to safety before commencing treatment.

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: As the agents take them away, the forgotten bloodlust sweeps across the battlefield once more.
units.displayText: As the agents take them away, the forgotten bloodlust sweeps across the battlefield once more.

spans.text: As the agents take them away, the forgotten bloodlust sweeps across the battlefield once more.

units.rawText: Magrasea's king looks down at us through the smoke of the battlefield. He raises his finger to his lips in a shushing gesture.
units.displayText: Magrasea's king looks down at us through the smoke of the battlefield. He raises his finger to his lips in a shushing gesture.

spans.text: Magrasea's king looks down at us through the smoke of the battlefield. He raises his finger to his lips in a shushing gesture.

units.rawText: <color=red>My dear audience, may I welcome you to the grand finale.</color>
units.displayText: My dear audience, may I welcome you to the grand finale.

spans.text: My dear audience, may I welcome you to the grand finale.

units.rawText: Relax, that big stupid jellyfish was just a warmup for me.
units.displayText: Relax, that big stupid jellyfish was just a warmup for me.

spans.text: Relax, that big stupid jellyfish was just a warmup for me.

units.rawText: Linny...
units.displayText: Linny...

spans.text: Linny...

units.rawText: Looks like we're all thinking the same thing.
units.displayText: Looks like we're all thinking the same thing.

spans.text: Looks like we're all thinking the same thing.
